            grangs nyung pa dgag pa ni <rs type="person" ana="corpusmd:unnamed_reference" ref="db:4207">blo chung ngur gyur kyang mchog du rlom pa kha cig</rs> <note type="editorial">The author of this view is identified as Me dig pa (ID:4207) in (ID:5507).</note> mi srid pa ni mtshon bya la ye med pa dang ma khyab pa phyogs cig la med pa dang khyab ches gzhan la'ang zhugs pa yin pas de gsum du nges te | <lb n="27'b3"/> mtshan nyid yin pa la de gsum dang bral dgos pa dang de gsum dang ma bral na mtshan nyid ma yin pa'i phyir ro | de gsum dang bral ba tsam gyis mtshan nyid du 'gyur ba ma nges so zhes zer ba | 
            de'i ltar na mtshan nyid kyi skyon mi srid pa dang khyab ches pa gnyis su nges te mtshan nyid yin pa la de gnyis dang bral dgos pa'i phyir dang de gnyis dang ma bral na mtshan nyid <lb n="27'b4"/>  ma yin pa'i phyir ro |</seg></TEI>
